title: Red Alert 2 HD Assets for Red Alert
description:
[h1]Red Alert 2 HD Assets[/h1]

Red Alert 2 units, sounds and voices for Red Alert, in HD. Built for Command & Conquer Remastered Collection.

This is an asset pack: on its own it adds nothing to the game. A mod has to use it.

The same pack for Tiberian Dawn is a separate item: each game reads art only from its own folder.

If the game crashes on the splash screen, the extra art needs more video memory than it has: add NOSPLASHPRELOAD to the game's launch options.

[h2]Using the assets in your own mod[/h2]

Every object, cameo and sound is named with the R2 prefix, so nothing clashes with the base game's own assets.

Enable this pack beside your mod (the game finds its art and sounds in any enabled mod) and copy the entries you need from this pack's Data/XML files into your mod's RA_*.XML, RABUILDABLES.XML and SFXEVENTS*.XML. Each object needs a classic-mode SHP with the same frame count (a transparent stub is enough) and its ImageData set in your DLL's Init or One_Time ([url=https://github.com/electronicarts/CnC_Remastered_Collection/blob/master/REDALERT/ADATA.CPP#L2590]EA's example[/url]).

Some stock tiles are animated: they hold several <Frame>s and an <AnimationData> FPS (the Red Alert Heavy Tank and Mammoth Tank turrets have 8 frames at 5 FPS). When you point an existing tile at this pack's art, replace its whole <Frames> list and remove its <AnimationData>, or the stock frames keep playing between yours.

[h2]Contents[/h2]

[b]Units[/b] (2): R2APOC, R2PRIS

[b]Sidebar cameos[/b] (2): BuildIcon_R2APOC, BuildIcon_R2PRIS

[b]Sounds (Data/AUDIO)[/b] (42): R2VAPOAT1A, R2VAPOAT2A, R2VAPOAT2B, R2VAPOAT2C, R2VAPOATA, R2VAPOATB, R2VAPOATC, R2VAPOATD, R2VAPOATE, R2VAPOATF, R2VAPOMOA, R2VAPOMOB, R2VAPOMOC, R2VAPOMOD, R2VAPOMOE, R2VAPOSEA, R2VAPOSEB, R2VAPOSEC, R2VAPOSED, R2VAPOSEE, R2VAPOSTAA, R2VAPOSTAB, R2VAPOSTAC, R2VPRIATA, R2VPRIATB, R2VPRIATC, R2VPRIATD, R2VPRIATE, R2VPRIATTA, R2VPRIMOA, R2VPRIMOB, R2VPRIMOC, R2VPRIMOD, R2VPRIMOE, R2VPRISEA, R2VPRISEB, R2VPRISEC, R2VPRISED, R2VPRISEE, R2VPRISTAA, R2VPRISTAB, R2VPRISTAC

XML files: RA2HDAssetsBuildables.xml, RA2HDAssets_UNITS.XML, SFXEventsRA2HDAssets.xml.

[h2]Shape data[/h2]

The classic sizes and frame counts of every object, and the frame layouts, are in the pinned discussion "Shape data" and in the README in the pack's folder.

[h2]AI disclosure[/h2]

The HD art in this pack was made with AI assistance. The 3D models behind the sprites were built and refined with AI tools, then rendered, checked and fitted to the game by hand, and every asset was reviewed in play in Red Alert before release.
The scripts and tools that build this pack were written with AI assistance. The original designs, sounds and voices are Westwood's and Electronic Arts'.

[h2]Credits[/h2]

Original Red Alert 2 art and sounds: Electronic Arts.
HD rebuilds of the Red Alert 2 designs and preparation for Remastered: gibbo101.
